run_libsize_check: run libsize.py on a .so file to display its size and compare against a saved baseline
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py with a new .so file to establish a size baseline in a save file
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare the current .so file size against a previously saved size
review_libsize_output: review the output of libsize.py to see byte and percentage change of a .so file
test_libsize_script: test libsize.py by passing a .so file and a save file to verify size comparison works
